Overall Performance Analysis

Meta Overall
Meta generated 1,547 messaging conversations from AED 28,433.66, a blended AED 18.38 per message, and reached 726,175 people. Volume was 12.3% lower than September (1,764) on similar spend. The higher blended cost reflects a larger share of budget moving to Engagement campaigns; excluding them, messaging campaigns delivered 1,539 messages at AED 15.49, slightly better than September (AED 16.01).
Instagram vs Facebook
Instagram delivered 849 messages (−22.4% vs September), with LASIK messaging costs rising to AED 20.10; LASIK ads and audiences were refreshed on 22 October in response. Presbyond held up well, led by the creative “26 Aug 2026” with 212 messages at AED 14.37. Facebook grew to 698 messages (+4.2%) while its cost per message fell to AED 12.84 (from AED 14.89), led by the Presbyond creative “en Jan 11, 2026” at AED 7.50 per message.
Service Mix
Presbyond became the largest service with 738 messages at AED 16.14, ahead of LASIK with 692 messages at AED 20.86. Cataract delivered 117 messages at AED 17.85, a clear efficiency improvement from AED 22.37 in September, with both platforms now at a similar cost (AED 18.06 Instagram, AED 17.65 Facebook).
Google Ads
Google recorded 70 tracked conversions (vs 136 in September) at AED 127.83 each, on slightly lower spend. Part of this drop is a tracking gap: after the landing page update the call button was removed and the floating WhatsApp button was not tracked during October (tracking has since been added). Clicks fell 20.2%, conversion rate dropped from 9.77% to 6.30%, and impression share lost to ad rank remains high at 60.76%.
Snapchat
Snapchat lead generation went live with a LASIK campaign, producing 12 leads from AED 879.58 at AED 73.30 per lead, with the “trans-prk” creative bringing 9 of them. We are working on optimizing the creatives, targeting and lead form to get a better cost per lead for good-quality leads.
TikTok
TikTok remained an awareness channel with a reduced budget of AED 444.69 (vs AED 1,421.34 in September), delivering 112,754 video views, 88,151 reach and 143 paid follows at a CPM of AED 3.90. Video views and reach were well below September (515,410 and 317,919), in line with spend being 68.7% lower.
LASIK Creatives
The main LASIK ads are showing creative fatigue after running for months: “Apr 12, 2026” rose from AED 12.01 per message in July to AED 21.66 in October, and “Jul 9, 2026” from AED 12.18 to AED 17.46. After the LASIK ads were edited and audiences refreshed on 22 October, LASIK cost per message fell 11% in the following week (AED 18.62 → AED 16.59), with messages per day up 11% at a similar daily spend; Instagram improved most (AED 22.06 → AED 18.74).
Lead Quality (Chatter)
From 5 October, Chatter received 1,502 new leads, 75.8% from ads, and 149 booked an appointment (9.9%). LASIK ads book better than Presbyond ads (7.6% vs 4.7%). The biggest drop-off points are the first qualifying question (23.1% of leads stop replying before any price is shared) and the price itself (21.7% go quiet right after receiving it), so the opening message flow and how price is presented are the main levers to lift bookings.

Actions

Actions Taken
  • LASIK ads edited and audiences refreshed (22 Oct). Cost per message dropped 11% in the following week, with more messages per day at a similar spend.
  • Snapchat lead generation launched for LASIK. We are testing creatives, targeting and the lead form to reach a better cost per lead with good-quality leads.
  • Tracking added to the floating WhatsApp button on the landing page, so Google WhatsApp conversions are measured again.
  • Presbyond Google Ads campaign launched (1 Nov), adding a search channel for Presbyond alongside LASIK.
Next Steps
  • Share bookings by source. The LASIK Facebook budget was reduced in October based on feedback that Facebook leads do not convert, yet in Chatter the Facebook LASIK ad “Apr 8, 2026” (“I thought it would be scary and painful”) has the highest booking rate among LASIK ads (11.0%, 8 of 73 leads). With bookings by source we can compare cost per booking on Facebook vs Instagram and set the LASIK budget split on that basis.
  • New LASIK content. Short, direct videos with the doctor and clear videos with patients after LASIK, the style that has driven LASIK’s best results, to replace the fatigued ads.
  • Add the call button back to the landing page, with call tracking.
  • Improve the conversation flow in Chatter. 45% of leads stop replying at the first question or right after the price; refining the opening message and how the price is presented is the main lever to lift bookings.
  • Keep testing Snapchat (creatives, targeting and lead form) before increasing its budget.
Ad Changes Based on Booking Rates

Using the Chatter booking rates (leads that booked an appointment, 5–31 October), budget was moved to the ads that bring patients who book, and ads that brought leads but no bookings were paused.
